main.description: Publish a member-signed kotoba graph head. The browser commits its Datom log into a Prolly tree, signs the root (ed25519 did:key, no-server-key per ADR-2605231525), and POSTs the root + signature + the delta blocks. The server VERIFIES the signature (it can never mint a root), stores the blocks in KV (content-addressed; the consumer re-verifies each CID on hydrate), and advances the published head under KV check-and-set keyed on prevRoot (optimistic concurrency; no operated Durable Object — ADR-2605262130 / 2605312345), with a per-publish block-count/size guardrail. The raw client IP is recorded server-side in a suppressable, oversight-key-encrypted attestation — never in the immutable blocks (ADR-2605312345 / 2606014600).

root.description: CIDv1 multibase of the committed Prolly-tree root.

did.description: did:key of the signing member (did:key:z + hex pubkey).

sig.description: Hex ed25519 signature over the raw root CID bytes.

prevRoot.description: The head the publisher rebased on (optimistic concurrency base). Advance only if it matches the current head; otherwise Conflict.

blocks.description: Delta Prolly-tree blocks the server lacks (see block.has). Content-addressed.

edit.description: Optional attribution hint for the edit that triggered this publish.

ipEncrypted.description: True when the raw IP was stored AES-GCM-encrypted under the oversight key.

errors.name: BadRequest
errors.description: Malformed JSON or missing required root/did/sig.

errors.name: BadSignature
errors.description: ed25519 verification of sig over root failed.

errors.name: Conflict
errors.description: The head advanced since prevRoot; response carries currentRoot — rebase and retry.

errors.name: TooManyBlocks
errors.description: Block count exceeds the per-publish bound (max 64).

errors.name: PublishUnavailable
errors.description: The publish store (ACTOR_KV) is not bound.
